sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: November 16, 2004, 41-year-old Kanarinka Simianoska contacted the local police station in Ketchevo,
sentences.zh: 2004年11月16日，41岁的卡娜琳卡·西米亚诺斯卡联系了基切沃当地的警察局，
zh_words: 卡娜琳卡·西米亚诺斯卡

sentences.en: a small city located in western Macedonia, to report her mother, Mitra, to be missing.
sentences.zh: 基切沃是马其顿西部的一座小城，她报案称自己的母亲米特拉失踪了。

sentences.en: The 64-year-old retired cleaner and housekeeper had left her home earlier that day for a trip to the market, and hadn't been seen since.
sentences.zh: 64岁的米特拉是一位退休的清洁工和管家，当天早些时候出门去市场，此后再未露面。

sentences.en: Kanarinka originally thought her mother may have gone to visit some family members after going to the market,
sentences.zh: 卡娜琳卡起初以为母亲去市场后可能顺道去探望亲戚了，

sentences.en: but as time passed and Mitra failed to return home, her daughter's worry increased.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间流逝，米特拉迟迟未归，女儿心中的担忧愈发强烈。

sentences.en: An inspection of Mitra's house showed no signs of forced entry or anything to suggest the struggle had taken place,
sentences.zh: 对米特拉家的检查显示，没有强行闯入的痕迹，也没有任何迹象表明发生过搏斗，

sentences.en: and there were no other clues to indicate where she may have gone.
sentences.zh: 也没有其他线索能指出她可能去了哪里。

sentences.en: Kanarinka pressed the Ketchevo police chief to launch an investigation into her mother's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 卡娜琳卡敦促基切沃警察局长对她母亲的失踪展开调查，

sentences.en: but she was met with reluctance, and an unnerving sense that the police viewed her with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 但对方表现得十分勉强，而且有一种令人不安的感觉，似乎警方对她本人也心存怀疑。

sentences.en: When they asked her to pay them money to conduct an investigation, a frustrated Kanarinka sought help elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 当警方要求她支付费用才肯进行调查时，心灰意冷的卡娜琳卡转而寻求其他帮助。

sentences.en: She walked a hundred metres down the road from her mother's home to the house belonging to renowned freelance journalist Vlado Terneski.
sentences.zh: 她从母亲家沿着路走了百米，来到了著名自由撰稿人弗拉多·塔内斯基的住处。

sentences.en: As the primary national news contact for the municipality of Ketchevo,
sentences.zh: 作为基切沃市主要的全国新闻联络人，

sentences.en: Vlado typically covered controversial political topics that plagued the region, ranging from police corruption to rising unemployment and illegal logging.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多通常报道困扰该地区的争议性政治话题，从警界腐败到失业率上升和非法伐木，应有尽有。

sentences.en: While he had covered crime stories before, most were related to less serious issues like petty theft.
sentences.zh: 虽然他以前也报道过犯罪新闻，但大多与轻微盗窃等较轻的案件有关。

sentences.en: Despite this, when Kanarinka Semyonowska stopped by his house requesting he write an article about her mother's disappearance, Vlado agreed.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，当卡娜琳卡·西米亚诺斯卡来到他家请求他为母亲的失踪写一篇报道时，弗拉多还是答应了。
zh_words: 卡娜琳卡·西米亚诺斯卡

sentences.en: When the article was published, it garnered local curiosity, but resulted in no leads.
sentences.zh: 文章发表后，引起了当地人的好奇，但并未带来任何线索。

sentences.en: As days passed with no sign of Mitra, Kanarinka became increasingly worried that her mother had met with harm.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，米特拉音讯全无，卡娜琳卡越来越担心母亲已经遭遇不测。

sentences.en: Yet friends and neighbours held little concern, as rumours speculated that Mitra probably ran away to escape a jealous boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 然而，朋友和邻居们并不怎么担心，因为坊间传闻米特拉可能是为了躲避嫉妒心强的男友而私奔了，

sentences.en: or had simply relocated elsewhere and was safe and well.
sentences.zh: 又或者只是搬到了别处，平安无事。

sentences.en: In the following weeks, Vlado Terneski continued to investigate Mitra's disappearance, scouting for information by interviewing her known acquaintances,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，弗拉多·塔内斯基继续调查米特拉的失踪案，通过采访她认识的熟人来搜集信息，

sentences.en: but nothing worthwhile came to light.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何有价值的线索浮出水面。

sentences.en: Mitra Semyonowska had vanished without a trace.
sentences.zh: 米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡就这样消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: Almost two months later, on January 12, 2005, a scrap collector was scavenging through the neglected construction site of a sports stadium on the outskirts of Ketchevo.
sentences.zh: 近两个月后的2005年1月12日，一名废品回收员在基切沃郊区一个被废弃的体育场建筑工地上搜寻。

sentences.en: As he foraged through the piles of junk and waste searching for anything of worth, he noticed something at the base of a steel construction frame.
sentences.zh: 当他在垃圾堆里翻找有价值的东西时，他注意到钢结构框架底部有什么东西。

sentences.en: There, in a shallow hole under a pile of rubbish and heavy stones, was a plastic garbage bag containing what appeared to be human remains.
sentences.zh: 在那里，在垃圾和重石堆下的一个浅坑里，有一个塑料垃圾袋，里面装着看起来像是人类遗骸的东西。

sentences.en: The Macedonian city of Ketchevo is situated within the slopes of Bistro Mountain.
sentences.zh: 马其顿城市基切沃坐落在比斯特拉山的山坡上。

sentences.en: It offers little appeal for visitors, with its post-Yugoslavian buildings, crumbled sidewalks, and bleak houses in desperate need of renovation.
sentences.zh: 这里对游客几乎没有吸引力，到处是后南斯拉夫时代的建筑、破碎的人行道，以及急需翻修的破败房屋。

sentences.en: Most tourists don't bother stopping through, only glimpsing its sign on the journey south from Macedonia's capital of Skopje to Lake Okrid on the Albanian border.
sentences.zh: 大多数游客根本不会在此停留，只是在从马其顿首都斯科普里前往阿尔巴尼亚边境奥赫里德湖的南下途中，匆匆瞥一眼路标。

sentences.en: As was the case with most post-Yugoslavian states, the Macedonian government invested its money into more prominent and popular locales.
sentences.zh: 正如大多数后南斯拉夫国家的情况一样，马其顿政府将资金投入到了更显眼、更受欢迎的地方。

sentences.en: This meant smaller towns and villages like Ketchevo were often overlooked and forgotten, deteriorating quickly as they fell behind the fast-paced advances of modern life.
sentences.zh: 这意味着像基切沃这样的小城镇往往被忽视和遗忘，随着现代生活节奏的加快，它们迅速衰败。

sentences.en: Life was slow in Ketchevo, where its 20,000 residents enjoyed a quiet and relatively peaceful existence, harboured by a close-knit community with strong traditional values.
sentences.zh: 基切沃的生活节奏缓慢，2万名居民享受着宁静祥和的生活，这里有着紧密团结的社区和深厚的传统价值观。

sentences.en: As such, Ketchevo was rarely mentioned on national Macedonian news, but as word began to spread about the body found at the abandoned sports stadium,
sentences.zh: 因此，基切沃很少出现在马其顿的全国新闻中，但随着废弃体育场发现遗体的消息传开，

sentences.en: Ketchevo was suddenly making national headlines.
sentences.zh: 基切沃突然登上了全国头条。

sentences.en: The chilling discovery shocked even the most hardened of Ketchevo's local police officers.
sentences.zh: 这一令人毛骨悚然的发现震惊了基切沃当地最老练的警察，

sentences.en: who were used to dealing with incidences of theft and domestic violence in their small town, but rarely murder.
sentences.zh: 他们习惯了处理小镇上的盗窃和家庭暴力事件，却很少遇到谋杀案。

sentences.en: The victim was soon identified as missing 64-year-old Mitra Semyonovska.
sentences.zh: 受害者很快被确认为失踪的64岁妇女米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡。

sentences.en: Forensic testing revealed she had been brutally beaten, raped, tortured, and strangled to death, with telephone cords used to bind her legs together.
sentences.zh: 法医鉴定显示，她生前遭受了残酷的殴打、强奸、折磨，最后被勒死，凶手还用电话线将她的双腿捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Examiners calculated Mitra had only been deceased for approximately 10 days, meaning she was kept alive and tortured by her abductor for the two months she had been missing.
sentences.zh: 检查人员推算米特拉死亡时间仅约10天，这意味着她在失踪的两个月里一直被绑架者囚禁并折磨。

sentences.en: Community fear had little time to manifest, as police soon announced that several arrests had been made in relation to the crime.
sentences.zh: 社区的恐慌还没来得及蔓延，警方就宣布已就此案逮捕了几名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Less than two weeks before Mitra's body was found, senior citizen Radoslav Bozanowski was spending New Year's Eve alone at his house in Malkeds,
sentences.zh: 在米特拉的遗体被发现前不到两周，老年人拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基正在基切沃邻近小村庄马尔凯茨的家中独自过除夕，
zh_words: 拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基

sentences.en: a small village neighbouring Ketchevo, when suddenly two men aged in their late 20s broke into his home under the influence of drugs and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 突然，两名20多岁的男子在毒品和酒精的影响下闯入了他的家中。

sentences.en: Both assailants subjected Radoslav to extreme acts of physical and sexual torture,
sentences.zh: 两名袭击者对拉多斯拉夫实施了极端的身体和性折磨，

sentences.en: before beating him to death and fleeing the scene in possession of nothing more than some loose change.
sentences.zh: 随后将他殴打致死，逃离现场时只抢走了一些零钱。

sentences.en: The two perpetrators were promptly arrested and identified as Ketchevo locals,
sentences.zh: 两名肇事者很快被捕，身份确认为基切沃当地人，

sentences.en: Ante Rostesky and Igor Merchesky.
sentences.zh: 安特·罗斯特斯基和伊戈尔·梅尔切斯基。

sentences.en: When the remains of Mitra Semyonovska were discovered later that month with wounds similar to those found on Radoslav, a connection between the two murders was quickly established.
sentences.zh: 当米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡的遗体在当月晚些时候被发现，且伤口与拉多斯拉夫身上的伤口相似时，两起谋杀案之间的联系很快被建立起来。

sentences.en: This link was later confirmed during a police interrogation when Rostesky and Merchesky each confessed to both murders.
sentences.zh: 这一联系后来在警方审讯中得到证实，罗斯特斯基和梅尔切斯基两人都供认了这两起谋杀案。

sentences.en: But by the time their trial commenced months later in 2005,
sentences.zh: 但到了2005年几个月后审判开始时，

sentences.en: Rostesky and Merchesky retracted their confessions in relation to Mitra Semyonovska's murder, denying any and all involvement.
sentences.zh: 罗斯特斯基和梅尔切斯基撤回了关于米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡谋杀案的供词，否认有任何参与。

sentences.en: They claimed their confessions were false, given under duress after enduring severe beatings from interrogating police officers.
sentences.zh: 他们声称自己的供词是虚假的，是在遭受审讯警察的严刑拷打后被迫作出的。

sentences.en: Whilst both accused were able to provide exhaustive details about the crimes they committed against Radoslav, they claimed to know nothing about what happened to Mitra.
sentences.zh: 虽然两名被告都能提供他们对拉多斯拉夫犯罪的详尽细节，但他们声称对米特拉的遭遇一无所知。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Ante Rostesky insisted he had a solid alibi for the day she went missing, as he had been working away from Ketchevo at the time of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 此外，安特·罗斯特斯基坚称他在她失踪当天有确凿的不在场证明，因为他在她失踪时正在基切沃以外的地方工作。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the judge found both of the accused guilty of double murder, and Ante Rostesky and Igor Merchesky were each sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，法官仍判处两名被告双重谋杀罪名成立，安特·罗斯特斯基和伊戈尔·梅尔切斯基各被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Given the disturbing nature of the two crimes in the otherwise peaceful city, the murder trial garnered intense interest from the national media.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这两起案件在原本平静的城市中性质恶劣，谋杀案审判引起了全国媒体的强烈关注。

sentences.en: In the courtroom, the press bench was full of reporters scribbling notes as they listened to the prosecution, defence, and evidence provided by witnesses.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，媒体席上挤满了记者，他们一边记录，一边听取控方、辩方和证人提供的证据。

sentences.en: Amongst the crowd was journalist Vlado Tanesky, observing the sad conclusion to Mitra's story that he had personally been covering since she initially vanished.
sentences.zh: 人群中就有记者弗拉多·塔内斯基，他正在观察米特拉悲剧的终结，而这个故事他从她最初失踪时就一直在报道。

sentences.en: In his subsequent article about the trial for daily newspaper Nova Macedonia, titled,
sentences.zh: 在他随后为日报《新马其顿》撰写的关于审判的文章中，标题为：

sentences.en: Surgical Gloves for a Monstrous Murder,
sentences.zh: “手术手套下的恐怖谋杀”，

sentences.en: Vlado wrote,
sentences.zh: 弗拉多写道：

sentences.en: In handcuffs and with searching eyes,
sentences.zh: “戴着手铐，眼神探寻，

sentences.en: 28-year-old Ante Rostesky and his friend Igor Merchesky, accused of a horrible double homicide in Ketchevo and Malketz, walked into the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 28岁的安特·罗斯特斯基和他的朋友伊戈尔·梅尔切斯基，因在基切沃和马尔凯茨犯下可怕的双重谋杀案而被指控，走进了法庭。

sentences.en: They stared vacantly at the ceiling, and from time to time whispered, as if to themselves,
sentences.zh: 他们空洞地盯着天花板，不时低声细语，仿佛在对自己说：

sentences.en: It's all over.
sentences.zh: ‘一切都结束了。’

sentences.en: And now we'll pay for our crimes.
sentences.zh: ‘现在我们要为自己的罪行付出代价了。’

sentences.en: In early November 2007, almost three years to the day since Mitra Semyonovska's abduction,
sentences.zh: 2007年11月初，距离米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡被绑架整整三年，

sentences.en: 56-year-old cleaner Lubitsa Lukoska left her house to buy groceries for lunch from a nearby supermarket.
sentences.zh: 56岁的清洁工卢比察·卢科斯卡离开家，去附近的超市买午餐用的杂货。

sentences.en: Two days later, she still hadn't returned home.
sentences.zh: 两天后，她仍未回家。

sentences.en: And on November 12,
Lubitsa's son,
sentences.zh: 卢比察的儿子，

sentences.en: Djuko, filed a missing persons report with the local police.
sentences.zh: 朱科，向当地警方提交了失踪人口报告。

sentences.en: As word of Lubitsa's disappearance began to spread, investigators were at a loss, as there was nothing to suggest she had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 随着卢比察失踪的消息传开，调查人员束手无策，因为没有任何迹象表明她遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: The 56-year-old was an upstanding citizen, a quiet, friendly woman who worked hard cleaning apartment buildings to support her family.
sentences.zh: 这位56岁的女性是一位受人尊敬的公民，一个安静、友善的女人，她努力工作，靠清洁公寓大楼来养家糊口。

sentences.en: Weeks passed, and with no sign of Lubitsa,
sentences.zh: 几周过去了，卢比察依然音讯全无，

sentences.en: Ketchevo locals began to speculate over the similarities between her disappearance and the abduction of Mitra Semyonovska three years earlier.
sentences.zh: 基切沃当地人开始猜测她的失踪与三年前米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡的绑架案之间存在相似之处。

sentences.en: They were also reminded of yet another missing woman,
sentences.zh: 他们还想起了另一位失踪的女性，

sentences.en: 73-year-old Goritsa Pavelska, a retired cleaner who was last seen five and a half years earlier on May 30, 2003.
sentences.zh: 73岁的戈里察·帕维尔斯卡，一位退休清洁工，最后一次露面是在五年半前的2003年5月30日。

sentences.en: At the time of her disappearance, neighbours theorised that Goritsa, who lived alone, had perhaps moved to Skopje to look for work without notifying anyone.
sentences.zh: 在她失踪时，邻居们推测独居的戈里察可能没通知任何人就搬到斯科普里找工作去了。

sentences.en: Alternatively, some speculated she may have suffered a heart attack or stroke while on her own in a remote area.
sentences.zh: 或者，有些人推测她可能在偏远地区独自一人时心脏病发作或中风了。

sentences.en: There was nothing at her apartment to suggest something untoward had happened, and her disappearance had been quickly pushed out of the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 她的公寓里没有任何迹象表明发生了什么不好的事情，她的失踪很快就被公众遗忘了。

sentences.en: But given what had happened since,
sentences.zh: 但考虑到后来发生的一切，

sentences.en: Goritsa's disappearance seemed far more sinister now.
sentences.zh: 戈里察的失踪现在看来要阴险得多。

sentences.en: On February 3, 2008, a truck driver was passing through the Ketchevo area on his way to the city of Gosteva,
sentences.zh: 2008年2月3日，一名卡车司机在前往戈斯蒂瓦尔市的途中经过基切沃地区，

sentences.en: when he stopped at a roadside refreshment area near the Strasja mountain range.
sentences.zh: 他在斯特拉斯贾山脉附近的一个路边休息区停了下来。

sentences.en: As he gazed down into the surrounding ravine, something caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 当他俯视周围的峡谷时，有什么东西引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: Sticking out from a rubbish-filled ditch was a human hand.
sentences.zh: 从一个堆满垃圾的沟渠里伸出了一只人手。

sentences.en: Police were instantly notified, and an autopsy confirmed the body in the ravine was that of missing woman Lubitsa Lekoska.
sentences.zh: 警方立即接到通知，尸检证实峡谷中的尸体正是失踪的卢比察·莱科斯卡。

sentences.en: Forensic testing revealed the 56-year-old had been beaten, raped, and strangled to death, her remains bound with telephone cords and wrapped in a plastic garbage bag.
sentences.zh: 法医鉴定显示，这位56岁的女性生前遭到殴打、强奸并被勒死，遗体被电话线捆绑并包裹在塑料垃圾袋中。

sentences.en: Lubitsa's death was calculated to have occurred just days before her body was discovered, indicating she was held captive for the three months she was missing.
sentences.zh: 卢比察的死亡时间被推算为遗体发现前几天，这表明她在失踪的三个月里一直被囚禁。

sentences.en: The similarities between the murders of Lubitsa Lekoska,
sentences.zh: 卢比察·莱科斯卡、

sentences.en: Mitra Semyonovka, and, to a lesser extent,
sentences.zh: 米特拉·西米亚诺斯卡，以及在较小程度上，

sentences.en: Radoslav Bozanowski, were too obvious to ignore, especially for freelance journalist Vlado Tanevsky, who had covered all cases extensively for local newspapers.
sentences.zh: 拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基的谋杀案之间的相似之处太明显了，无法忽视，尤其是对于一直为当地报纸广泛报道所有案件的自由撰稿人弗拉多·塔内斯基来说。
zh_words: 拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基

sentences.en: Days later, on February 6,
sentences.zh: 几天后的2月6日，

sentences.en: Vlado expressed his suspicions in an article for Macedonia's Morning Herald newspaper.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多在马其顿《晨报》的一篇文章中表达了他的怀疑。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: He speculated over the possible scenarios that could have led to Lubitsa's abduction, putting forward the possibility that the attack may not have been premeditated.
sentences.zh: 他推测了可能导致卢比察被绑架的各种情况，提出了袭击可能并非预谋的可能性。

sentences.en: He suggested she may have been hit by a car, and instead of the driver coming to her aid, they saw it as an opportunity to take advantage of the situation.
sentences.zh: 他暗示她可能被车撞了，而司机没有伸出援手，反而将其视为利用局势的机会。

sentences.en: Weeks later, on the evening of May 7, 2008,
sentences.zh: 几周后的2008年5月7日晚上，

sentences.en: 65-year-old Zivana Temelkoska, a retired janitor who now worked as a local cleaner, was sitting alone in her apartment when she received a startling phone call from a friend.
sentences.zh: 65岁的齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡，一位退休的门卫，现在做当地清洁工，正独自坐在公寓里，突然接到了一位朋友打来的惊人电话。

sentences.en: They had been listening to local community radio station Canal 77 when they heard the news that Zivana's son, Zoran, had been involved in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正在收听当地社区广播电台Canal 77，听到了齐瓦娜的儿子佐兰遭遇车祸的消息。

sentences.en: Neighbours witnessed Zivana fleeing the apartment building with a worried expression on her face, walking at a fast pace in the direction of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 邻居们目睹齐瓦娜神色焦虑地跑出公寓大楼，快步朝医院方向走去。

sentences.en: In actuality, Zoran had not been involved in an accident and was perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 事实上，佐兰并没有发生事故，一切安好。

sentences.en: He returned home later that evening to find the apartment empty.
sentences.zh: 他当晚晚些时候回到家，发现公寓空无一人。

sentences.en: When his mother failed to return home that night,
sentences.zh: 当他的母亲当晚没有回家时，

sentences.en: Zoran questioned friends and neighbours, discovering the bizarre circumstances that led to Zivana fleeing the building.
sentences.zh: 佐兰询问了朋友和邻居，发现了导致齐瓦娜逃离大楼的离奇情况。

sentences.en: Worried, Zoran contacted police to report his mother missing, only to discover there had been no reported car accidents that evening.
sentences.zh: 焦急的佐兰联系警方报案母亲失踪，结果发现当晚根本没有发生过车祸报道。

sentences.en: This revelation raised the likelihood that the radio broadcast about Zoran's accident was not done in error, but was an elaborate hoax to lure Zivana from her apartment
sentences.zh: 这一发现增加了这种可能性：关于佐兰事故的广播并非失误，而是一个精心策划的骗局，旨在将齐瓦娜从公寓中引出，

sentences.en: by whomever was responsible for her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 由任何应对她失踪负责的人所为。

sentences.en: The next day, a woman walking on a street near the local kindergarten heard a ringing sound
sentences.zh: 第二天，一名在当地幼儿园附近街道上行走的妇女听到了一阵铃声，

sentences.en: coming from nearby and followed the noise to a discarded mobile phone lying in a patch of grass.
sentences.zh: 她循声而去，发现草丛中丢弃着一部手机。

sentences.en: She decided to answer the call and was startled when a police officer spoke to her, asking the woman to identify herself and ordering her to stay put.
sentences.zh: 她决定接听电话，当一名警察与她通话，要求她表明身份并命令她留在原地时，她大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Police arrived on the scene and confirmed the mobile phone as belonging to Zivana Temelkoska.
sentences.zh: 警方赶到现场，确认该手机属于齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡。

sentences.en: Given the location where the phone was found, police believed it had been thrown out of a moving vehicle.
sentences.zh: 鉴于发现手机的位置，警方认为它是从行驶的车辆中扔出来的。

sentences.en: They were now convinced Zivana had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 他们现在确信齐瓦娜遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: On May 16, 2008, nine days after Zivana vanished, a passerby at a soccer field on the outskirts of town made a disturbing discovery.
sentences.zh: 2008年5月16日，在齐瓦娜失踪九天后，一名路人在镇郊的一处足球场有了令人不安的发现。

sentences.en: Amongst a pile of rubbish, they found a plastic garbage bag containing the body of Zivana Temelkoska.
sentences.zh: 在一堆垃圾中，他们发现了一个塑料垃圾袋，里面装着齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡的遗体。

sentences.en: The 65-year-old cleaner had been raped, tortured and strangled, her body bound with telephone cords.
sentences.zh: 这位65岁的清洁工遭到强奸、折磨并被勒死，遗体被电话线捆绑。

sentences.en: Similarities were immediately drawn to the murders of Mitra Temelkoska in 2005 and Lubitsa Temelkoska just months earlier, with only one obvious difference.
sentences.zh: 人们立即将其与2005年的米特拉·特梅尔科斯卡和几个月前的卢比察·特梅尔科斯卡的谋杀案联系起来，只有一个明显的区别。

sentences.en: Unlike the other victims who had been found naked,
sentences.zh: 与其他被发现时赤身裸体的受害者不同，

sentences.en: Zivana was wearing a green polka dot nightgown, an item of clothing that did not belong to her.
sentences.zh: 齐瓦娜穿着一件绿色波点睡裙，那件衣服并不属于她。

sentences.en: Further forensic examination revealed Zivana had likely been killed on the same day of her abduction.
sentences.zh: 进一步的法医检查显示，齐瓦娜很可能在被绑架的当天就被杀害了。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed she had suffered multiple internal and external injuries, including five broken ribs, 13 knife wounds to the skull, and had endured violent sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示她遭受了多处内外伤，包括五根肋骨骨折、颅骨上有13处刀伤，并遭受了暴力性侵犯。

sentences.en: Traces of semen found on Zivana's body were sent off for DNA testing as a police spokesperson fronted the media, saying,
sentences.zh: 在齐瓦娜身上发现的精液痕迹被送去进行DNA检测，一名警方发言人面对媒体时说：

sentences.en: We are talking about a violent death caused in an exceptionally monstrous way.
sentences.zh: “我们谈论的是一种以极其残暴的方式造成的暴力死亡。”

sentences.en: Rumours that a serial killer was active in Kechevo presented a sensational news story.
sentences.zh: 关于基切沃出现连环杀手的传言成了一个轰动的新闻故事。

sentences.en: Vlado Toneski, who had been reporting on the string of murders from their outset, made the connection between victims by the killer's weapon of choice,
sentences.zh: 一直从一开始就报道这一系列谋杀案的弗拉多·塔内斯基，通过凶手的作案工具将受害者联系了起来，

sentences.en: a telephone cord which was then used to bind their bodies.
sentences.zh: 即用来捆绑尸体的电话线。

sentences.en: A unique detail too specific to be a mere coincidence.
sentences.zh: 这是一个太具体而不可能仅仅是巧合的独特细节。

sentences.en: On May 19, 2008, following the discovery of Zivana Temelkoska,
sentences.zh: 2008年5月19日，在发现齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡之后，

sentences.en: Vlado Toneski wrote,
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·塔内斯基写道：

sentences.en: The people of Kechevo live in fear and panic after another butchered body of a woman from the town was found this weekend.
sentences.zh: “本周末又发现了一具来自该镇的女性被肢解的尸体，基切沃的人民生活在恐惧和恐慌之中。”

sentences.en: The local police and the citizens too see the mysterious disappearance and hideous deaths of Zivana Temelkoska and Lubitsa Lekoska as an act of the same man.
sentences.zh: “当地警方和市民也都认为齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡和卢比察·莱科斯卡的神秘失踪和惨死是同一个人的所作所为。”

sentences.en: A serial killer.
sentences.zh: “一个连环杀手。”

sentences.en: Police sources confirm the existence of a serial murderer in the town based on the fact that the women were tortured and killed in the same way,
sentences.zh: “警方消息人士证实，镇上存在一名连环杀手，依据是这些女性遭受折磨并以同样的方式被杀害，

sentences.en: which eliminates the possibility that this was done by different people.
sentences.zh: 这排除了这是由不同人所为的可能性。”

sentences.en: The article explained that although investigators had interrogated several suspects, all had been released from custody shortly afterwards, meaning the killer was still at large.
sentences.zh: 文章解释说，尽管调查人员审讯了几名嫌疑人，但所有人都很快被释放，这意味着凶手仍然逍遥法外。

sentences.en: The journalist then coined the name the unknown killer would come to be known as, stating,
sentences.zh: 这位记者随后为这个未知的杀手起了一个名字，写道：

sentences.en: The motives of the Kechevo monster remain unclear.
sentences.zh: “基切沃怪物的动机尚不清楚。”

sentences.en: The concept of a serial killer targeting the townspeople seemed so alien that even the mayor of Kechevo stated his disbelief.
sentences.zh: 连环杀手针对镇民的概念显得如此陌生，以至于连基切沃市长都表示难以置信。

sentences.en: Quote, We have seen something like that only in films, western films about serial killers.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：“我们只在电影里见过这样的事情，关于连环杀手的西部片。”

sentences.en: In our town, nobody could ever assume this could happen.
sentences.zh: “在我们的镇上，没有人会想到这会发生。”

sentences.en: But there it was.
sentences.zh: “但它确实发生了。”

sentences.en: It happened.
sentences.zh: “它发生了。”

sentences.en: And right in our neighbourhood too.
sentences.zh: “而且就在我们的社区里。”

sentences.zh: Casefile 节目稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that her killers had already been convicted, questions still remained as to whether or not Mitra Semyonovsky could have been a victim of the Kechevo monster.
sentences.zh: 尽管杀害她的凶手早已被定罪，但关于米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡（Mitra Semyonovsky）是否可能是“基切沃怪物”（Kechevo monster）受害者的疑问依然存在。
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡

sentences.en: Ante Rosteski and Igor Mercheski continued to profess their innocence for her murder, insisting the confessions they provided in 2005 were false.
sentences.zh: 安特·罗斯特斯基（Ante Rosteski）和伊戈尔·梅尔切斯基（Igor Mercheski）坚称自己并未谋杀她，并坚持认为他们在2005年所做的供述是虚假的。

sentences.en: Given Mitra's crime scene bore parallels to those of Lubitsa Lukoska and Zivana Temelkoska, who were abducted and killed whilst Rosteski and Mercheski were serving time in prison,
sentences.zh: 鉴于米特拉的案发现场与卢比察·卢科斯卡（Lubitsa Lukoska）和齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡（Zivana Temelkoska）的案件有相似之处，而这两名受害者是在罗斯特斯基和梅尔切斯基服刑期间被绑架并杀害的，

sentences.en: a judge requested a review of Mitra Semyonovsky's case.
sentences.zh: 法官要求对米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡的案件进行复审。
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡

sentences.en: The subsequent inquiry exposed a major error in the original investigation, when it was revealed that semen obtained from Mitra's body at the time of her murder
sentences.zh: 随后的调查揭露了最初调查中的一个重大错误，当时披露的信息显示，在米特拉遇害时从她体内提取的精液

sentences.en: did not match either Rosteski or Mercheski's DNA.
sentences.zh: 与罗斯特斯基或梅尔切斯基的 DNA 均不匹配。

sentences.en: This critical information was known by investigators prior to the trial in 2005, but was never presented in court.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在2005年审判前就已经掌握了这一关键信息，但从未在法庭上出示过。

sentences.en: Although police insisted this crucial DNA evidence had been passed on to all relevant parties at the
sentences.zh: 尽管警方坚称这一关键的 DNA 证据在当时已经移交给了所有相关方，

sentences.en: time, including the public prosecutor, it soon became clear that the DNA results were intentionally withheld to ensure a speedy conviction for Mitra Semyonovsky's brutal murder.
sentences.zh: 包括检察官，但很快人们就清楚地发现，这些 DNA 结果是被故意隐瞒的，目的是为了确保米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡这起残忍谋杀案能被迅速定罪。
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡

sentences.en: Following this revelation, Ante Rosteski and Igor Mercheski were cleared for the wrongful conviction of the murder of Mitra Semyonovsky, but remained incarcerated for the murder of
sentences.zh: 在这一真相大白后，安特·罗斯特斯基和伊戈尔·梅尔切斯基因米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡谋杀案的冤案被洗清了罪名，但他们仍因拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基（Radoslav Bozanovsky）的谋杀案而继续入狱，
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡
拉多斯拉夫·博扎诺夫斯基

sentences.en: Radoslav Bozanovsky, which they continued to accept responsibility for.
sentences.zh: 而他们一直承认对这起案件负责。

sentences.en: No one was held responsible for suppressing the DNA evidence that ultimately proved their innocence.
sentences.zh: 最终没有人为隐瞒证明他们清白的 DNA 证据而承担责任。

sentences.en: The error became a major embarrassment for Kitchevo police and the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 这一错误成为了基切沃警方和司法部门的一大丑闻。

sentences.en: Their unethical actions enabling the Kitchevo monster to continue to roam freely and harm others.
sentences.zh: 他们不道德的行为使得“基切沃怪物”能够继续逍遥法外并伤害他人。

sentences.en: With Mitra Semyonovsky's murder officially revised to one solved, the semen sample found on her body was tested against the sample found on Zivana Temelkoska.
sentences.zh: 随着米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡的谋杀案被正式修订为已破案件，在她尸体上发现的精液样本被拿来与在齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡身上发现的样本进行了比对。
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡

sentences.en: While neither sample matched any known offenders within the criminal database, the semen found on both victims was confirmed to have come
sentences.zh: 虽然两个样本都与犯罪数据库中任何已知的罪犯不匹配，但证实两名受害者身上发现的精液均来自

sentences.en: from the same perpetrator, expelling any doubts that a serial killer was at large.
sentences.zh: 同一名肇事者，这消除了关于是否存在连环杀手的任何疑虑。

sentences.en: In a bid to catch the Kitchevo monster, local law enforcement collaborated with the superiorly resourced Skopje police force to create a psychological profile of their suspect.
sentences.zh: 为了抓住“基切沃怪物”，当地执法部门与资源更充足的斯科普里警方合作，对嫌疑人进行了心理侧写。

sentences.en: They deduced he was likely a middle-aged male with the substantial physical strength required to restrain and strangle his victims before transporting their bodies.
sentences.zh: 他们推断他很可能是一名中年男性，拥有足够的体力来制服并勒死受害者，然后再转移尸体。

sentences.en: He had to be intimately familiar with Kitchevo, and given there was no evidence of a struggle at any of his victims' homes
sentences.zh: 他必须对基切沃非常熟悉，而且鉴于在任何受害者的家中

sentences.en: or elsewhere, it was possible he was known and trusted by each woman.
sentences.zh: 或其他地方都没有发现挣扎的痕迹，他很可能被每位女性所熟知并信任。

sentences.en: The abductions and subsequent slayings appeared to be planned in advance, suggesting the killer had a higher than average
sentences.zh: 这些绑架和随后的杀戮似乎是预先策划好的，这表明凶手拥有高于平均水平的

sentences.en: intelligence, while the similarities between each implied he was well organised.
sentences.zh: 智力，而每起案件之间的相似之处暗示他组织严密。

sentences.en: The killer's haphazard way of discarding his victims within city limits was explained by a police spokesperson
sentences.zh: 警方发言人解释了凶手在城市范围内随意弃尸的行为，

sentences.en: who stated, Whether it was three weeks or three years after they were murdered, the killer wanted the bodies to be found.
sentences.zh: 他表示：“无论是在她们被杀三周后还是三年后，凶手都希望尸体被发现。”

sentences.en: The killer's preferred victim suggested he harboured sexual frustration towards older women that had likely stemmed from childhood trauma and developed into sadomasochistic
sentences.zh: 凶手偏好的受害者类型表明，他对年长女性怀有性挫折感，这很可能源于童年创伤，并发展成了施虐受虐的

sentences.en: desires.
sentences.zh: 欲望。

sentences.en: Although it couldn't be ruled out that the Kitchevo monster had an accomplice, investigators believed he acted alone.
sentences.zh: 尽管不能排除“基切沃怪物”有同伙的可能性，但调查人员认为他是单独作案。

sentences.en: The psychological profile enabled police to narrow down their search, but a large pool of potential suspects remained.
sentences.zh: 心理侧写使警方缩小了搜查范围，但仍有大量潜在嫌疑人。

sentences.en: A much-needed breakthrough in the investigation came when a jersey located near Zivana Temelkoska's body was found to contain traces of an unknown person's
sentences.zh: 调查的一个重大突破出现在齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡尸体附近发现的一件运动衫上，上面含有不明人士的

sentences.en: blood, opening up the possibility it belonged to her killer.
sentences.zh: 血迹，这开启了它属于凶手的可能性。

sentences.en: Police had the blood sample tested to determine the blood type, allowing the suspect pool to be narrowed down further.
sentences.zh: 警方对血样进行了检测以确定血型，从而进一步缩小了嫌疑人范围。

sentences.en: Through a process of elimination, the number of suspects was whittled down to approximately 150 men.
sentences.zh: 通过排除法，嫌疑人数量减少到了大约150人。

sentences.en: Each was brought in for police questioning and were eliminated one by one, bringing the list down to just 10 names.
sentences.zh: 每个人都被带去接受警方审讯并被逐一排除，名单缩减到了仅剩10人。

sentences.en: After verifying the alibis of the 10 remaining persons of interest, police were left with just three likely suspects.
sentences.zh: 在核实了剩余10名相关人员的不在场证明后，警方只剩下三名主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: DNA samples were taken from each, but would take days to be tested against evidence collected from the crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 警方提取了每个人的 DNA 样本，但需要几天时间才能与从案发现场收集的证据进行比对。

sentences.en: The comprehensive efforts undertaken by police were eagerly overseen by the media, including the main reporter responsible for covering the case,
sentences.zh: 警方所做的全面努力受到了媒体的热切关注，其中包括负责报道此案的主要记者，

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特尔内斯基（Vlado Terneski）。

sentences.en: In one newspaper article, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 他在一篇报纸文章中写道：

sentences.en: Several teams of police experts are working day and night in the field and the laboratory to establish the identity of the serial killer.
sentences.zh: “几支警察专家小组正在实地和实验室里昼夜不停地工作，以确定这名连环杀手的身份。”

sentences.en: Yet, unbeknownst to the press and public, investigators were already confident they had identified the Kachevo monster.
sentences.zh: 然而，媒体和公众并不知道，调查人员已经确信他们锁定了“基切沃怪物”。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of June 20, 2008, Ognan Carcharic, an editor for daily newspaper Nova
sentences.zh: 2008年6月20日下午，《新马其顿》（Nova Macedonia）日报的编辑奥格南·卡尔查里奇（Ognan Carcharic）

sentences.en: Macedonia, received a phone call from one of his contacts at the Kachevo Police Department, advising that an arrest had been made in relation to the recent spate of murders.
sentences.zh: 接到了基切沃警察局一位联系人的电话，告知他与近期发生的一系列谋杀案有关的嫌疑人已被逮捕。

sentences.en: His contact wouldn't disclose the identity of the suspect in custody, but Ognan verified the information with the Ministry of the Interior, who confirmed it to be true.

sentences.en: When the Kachevo monster began his reign of terror,
sentences.zh: 当卡切沃怪物开始他的恐怖统治时，

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski secured himself as the lead reporter on the case, interviewing friends and family of the victims whilst writing up stories for several major publications,
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特内斯基将自己确立为该案的首席记者，他采访了受害者的亲友，并为多家大型出版物撰写报道，

sentences.en: ensuring his content received nationwide coverage.
sentences.zh: 确保他的内容获得了全国性的报道。

sentences.en: When Mitra Semyonovska disappeared,
sentences.zh: 当米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡失踪时，
zh_words: 米特拉·塞米奥诺夫斯卡

sentences.en: Terneski agreed to write an article about the case on behalf of her daughter, Kanarinka.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基同意代表她的女儿卡娜琳卡撰写一篇关于此案的文章。

sentences.en: Yet, even after two men were convicted for Mitra's murder,
sentences.zh: 然而，即使在两名男子因米特拉的谋杀案被定罪后，

sentences.en: Terneski inexplicitly continued to investigate and report on the crime.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基仍莫名其妙地继续调查并报道这起罪行。

sentences.en: When Lubitsa Lekoska disappeared,
sentences.zh: 当卢比察·莱科斯卡失踪时，

sentences.en: Terneski met with her worried family and sat with her sister, as she described Lubitsa as quiet and gentle, details he later used in his articles on the missing woman.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基会见了她焦急的家人，并与她的姐妹坐在一起，听她描述卢比察安静而温柔的性格，这些细节后来被他用在了关于这位失踪女性的文章中。

sentences.en: Lubitsa's sister later stated,
sentences.zh: 卢比察的姐妹后来表示，

sentences.en: I never suspected that he was the murderer.
sentences.zh: 我从未怀疑过他是凶手。

sentences.en: I knew him as a good, honest person.
sentences.zh: 我认识的他是一个善良、诚实的人。

sentences.en: We weren't close at all.
sentences.zh: 我们一点也不亲近。

sentences.en: But we were neighbours.
sentences.zh: 但我们是邻居。

sentences.en: Terneski door-knocked to the area when Zivana Temelkoska disappeared, again interviewing neighbours, relatives and law enforcement,
sentences.zh: 当齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡失踪时，特内斯基挨家挨户敲门，再次采访了邻居、亲属和执法人员，

sentences.en: before publishing his findings in articles on the crime.
sentences.zh: 随后将他的调查结果发表在关于这起罪行的文章中。

sentences.en: Her son Zoran stated,
sentences.zh: 她的儿子佐兰说，

sentences.en: When my mother disappeared, Terneski asked me questions.
sentences.zh: 我母亲失踪时，特内斯基问了我一些问题。

sentences.en: Even when he met me in the street, he'd enquire if I had news or if I suspected anyone in particular.
sentences.zh: 即使他在街上遇到我，他也会询问我是否有消息，或者我是否怀疑特定的人。

sentences.en: We were neighbours for a long time, knew each other for years, so it never even crossed my mind that he might be the guilty one.
sentences.zh: 我们做了很长时间的邻居，认识多年，所以我也从未想过他可能是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: Upon learning that police had arrested the journalist in relation to his mother's murder,
sentences.zh: 在得知警方因他母亲的谋杀案逮捕了这位记者后，

sentences.en: Zoran said,
sentences.zh: 佐兰说，

sentences.en: You can't describe the feeling.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉无法形容。

sentences.en: It was very hard on me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说非常沉重。

sentences.en: To have someone kill your mother and then come to your house to say hi.
sentences.zh: 有人杀了你的母亲，然后又到你家来打招呼。

sentences.en: It's horrifying.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thorough searches of Vlado Terneski's properties uncovered a collection of pornographic videos and magazines at his family's remote summer cottage,
sentences.zh: 对弗拉多·特内斯基房产的彻底搜查，在他家偏远的避暑小屋中发现了一批色情视频和杂志，

sentences.en: along with various ropes and cords.
sentences.zh: 以及各种绳索和电线。

sentences.en: Items of clothing and shoes belonging to the victims were also found at the cottage, leading police to speculate he had held the women captive at his property,
sentences.zh: 小屋里还发现了属于受害者的衣物和鞋子，这导致警方推测他曾将这些女性囚禁在他的房产内，

sentences.en: where they were brutally tortured and sexually abused over an extended period of time, before he killed them and disposed of their bodies.
sentences.zh: 在那里她们在被杀害并处理尸体之前，曾长期遭受残酷的折磨和性虐待。

sentences.en: Vesna stood by her husband and insisted the items of clothing in question belonged to her late mother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 维斯娜支持她的丈夫，并坚称这些衣物属于她已故的婆婆。

sentences.en: Yet, the green polka dot nightgown
sentences.zh: 然而，那件绿色的波点睡袍，

sentences.en: Zivana Temelkoska was wearing at the time her body was discovered was believed to have once belonged to Vlado Terneski's mother, indicating a possible connection
sentences.zh: 齐瓦娜·特梅尔科斯卡在被发现尸体时所穿的衣服，被认为曾经属于弗拉多·特内斯基的母亲，这表明

sentences.en: between the murders and Terneski's maternal relationship.
sentences.zh: 这些谋杀案与特内斯基的母子关系之间可能存在联系。

sentences.en: Adding to this theory was the fact the victims shared many similarities with his mother,
sentences.zh: 支持这一理论的事实是，受害者与他的母亲有很多相似之处，

sentences.en: Goritsa Terneski, in that they were of similar age, appearance, and held the same job as a cleaner.
sentences.zh: 戈里察·特内斯基，她们年龄相仿、外貌相似，并且都从事清洁工的工作。

sentences.en: When interviewed for the documentary series
sentences.zh: 在接受纪录片系列

sentences.en: Evil Up Close,
sentences.zh: 《邪恶近距离》采访时，

sentences.en: British psychologist Emma Short explained to the likelihood that Terneski had selected his victims based on their similarities to his mother.
sentences.zh: 英国心理学家艾玛·肖特解释了特内斯基根据受害者与他母亲的相似之处来选择目标的可能性。

sentences.en: Considering the murder spree had begun after his mother's death, it was possible Terneski's desire to kill was linked to the loss.
sentences.zh: 考虑到谋杀狂潮是在他母亲去世后开始的，特内斯基的杀人欲望可能与这种丧亲之痛有关。

sentences.en: Emma Short, quote,
sentences.zh: 艾玛·肖特引用道，

sentences.en: He was clearly very strongly attached to her, but a strong attachment to a parent doesn't always mean love.
sentences.zh: 他显然与她有着非常强烈的依恋，但对父母的强烈依恋并不总是意味着爱。

sentences.en: Sometimes it can mean hate or resentment, but those things are just as powerful as love.
sentences.zh: 有时它可能意味着仇恨或怨恨，但这些情感与爱一样强大。

sentences.en: The day after Terneski was placed under arrest, the Ministry of Interior released a public statement announcing the Kachevo monster had finally been caught.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基被捕后的第二天，内政部发表了一份公开声明，宣布卡切沃怪物终于被抓获了。

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski's full name was released, along with details about his occupation and a list of the evidence so far collected against him.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特内斯基的全名被公布，同时还有关于他的职业以及迄今为止收集到的针对他的证据清单。

sentences.en: The revelations sent shockwaves throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 这些披露在全国范围内引起了轰动。

sentences.en: Macedonia's Morning Herald newspaper broke the major news story, which was unlike any the media or public had ever heard before.
sentences.zh: 马其顿的《晨报》率先报道了这条重大新闻，这是媒体或公众从未听说过的。

sentences.en: The article read,
sentences.zh: 文章写道，

sentences.en: Is it possible that around the family lived such a killer, who was hiding so skillfully behind the mask of loyal and faithful husband, proud father, gentle son-in-law,
sentences.zh: 难道在我们的家人身边住着这样一个杀手，他如此巧妙地隐藏在忠诚可靠的丈夫、骄傲的父亲、温柔的女婿、

sentences.en: and exemplary son?
sentences.zh: 以及模范儿子的面具之下吗？

sentences.en: Many refused to believe the allegations, with speculation rife that police had framed Terneski due to his intricate coverage of the case, which pointed out the many failings
sentences.zh: 许多人拒绝相信这些指控，坊间盛传警方是因为特内斯基对案件的深入报道而陷害他，因为他的报道指出了马其顿执法部门

sentences.en: of Macedonian law enforcement throughout the investigation.
sentences.zh: 在整个调查过程中的许多失误。

sentences.en: In an interview with Esquire magazine, a close friend and former colleague of Terneski's described his friend of 20 years as shy, humble, and unobtrusive.
sentences.zh: 在接受《时尚先生》杂志采访时，特内斯基的一位密友兼前同事将这位他认识 20 年的朋友描述为害羞、谦逊且不张扬的人。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用道，

sentences.en: I never felt there was any aggression, anger, or inhumanity within him.
sentences.zh: 我从未感觉到他内心有任何攻击性、愤怒或非人性。

sentences.en: Vlado just seemed completely normal.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多看起来完全正常。

sentences.en: When I heard that he was accused of being the serial killer, it was as if a lightning had struck me.
sentences.zh: 当我听说他被指控为连环杀手时，就像被闪电击中了一样。

sentences.en: In an article for the Financial Times, one of Terneski's former editors stated, To say that I was gobsmacked is an understatement.
sentences.zh: 在《金融时报》的一篇文章中，特内斯基的一位前编辑表示，说我惊呆了都算是轻描淡写。

sentences.en: I was speechless.
sentences.zh: 我当时说不出话来。

sentences.en: I was shaking.
sentences.zh: 我在发抖。

sentences.en: I couldn't believe he was the serial killer.
sentences.zh: 我无法相信他就是那个连环杀手。

sentences.en: And part of me still doesn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 而且我内心深处仍然不相信。

sentences.en: Even relatives of the Kachevo monster's victims were uncertain whether to believe the news.
sentences.zh: 即使是卡切沃怪物受害者的亲属也不确定是否该相信这个消息。

sentences.en: Lubitsa Lekoszka's sister said she could never have suspected
sentences.zh: 卢比察·莱科斯卡的姐妹说她永远无法怀疑

sentences.en: Terneski was the murderer, as she had only known him to be a good and honest person.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基是凶手，因为她只知道他是一个善良诚实的人。

sentences.en: Although, not everyone remembered him that way.
sentences.zh: 虽然，并不是每个人都这样记得他。

sentences.en: One neighbour described Terneski as a mysterious, silent man who never said so much as hello throughout his entire life.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居将特内斯基描述为一个神秘、沉默的男人，他一生中甚至从未打过招呼。

sentences.en: Another neighbour recalled him to be strange and antisocial.
sentences.zh: 另一位邻居回忆说他很奇怪且反社会。

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski was ordered to remain in police custody for a 30-day detention period before legal proceedings commenced.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特内斯基被下令在法律程序开始前继续接受 30 天的拘留。

sentences.en: He was assigned a public defender and transferred to a prison in Tertolvol, a town located 70 kilometres north of Kachevo.
sentences.zh: 他被指派了一名公设辩护人，并被转移到距离卡切沃以北 70 公里的特托尔沃监狱。

sentences.en: Upon his admission to prison, a medical review declared him to be of good health.
sentences.zh: 入狱时，医疗检查宣布他身体健康。

sentences.en: A prisoner accused of crimes as serious as Terneski's was expected to be treated carefully and provided with their own cell.
sentences.zh: 像特内斯基这样被指控犯有严重罪行的囚犯，理应受到谨慎对待并被单独关押。

sentences.en: However, like most of the jails in Macedonia at the time,
sentences.zh: 然而，像当时马其顿的大多数监狱一样，

sentences.en: Tertolvol prison was severely overcrowded.
sentences.zh: 特托尔沃监狱严重拥挤。

sentences.en: Terneski was placed into the only space available, a tiny cell consisting of two bunk beds and a grimy bathroom containing a toilet, sink, and a large bucket.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基被安置在唯一可用的空间里，那是一个狭小的牢房，里面有两张双层床和一个肮脏的浴室，里面有一个马桶、水槽和一个大桶。

sentences.en: The small cell already housed three inmates, two men in their 20s who had been charged for meddling in the recent parliamentary election, and a 49-year-old awaiting trial
sentences.zh: 这个小牢房里已经住了三名囚犯，两名 20 多岁的男子因干预最近的议会选举而被指控，还有一名 49 岁的男子正在等待审判，

sentences.en: for poisoning a 14-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 罪名是毒害一名 14 岁女孩。

sentences.en: Severe water restrictions meant taps were turned off during the day and inmates were instead provided with bottles of drinking water and plastic buckets to use
sentences.zh: 严格的用水限制意味着白天水龙头会被关闭，囚犯们只能获得瓶装饮用水和塑料桶用于

sentences.en: for personal hygiene.
sentences.zh: 个人卫生。

sentences.en: These restrictions occurred during daytime hours only and weren't enforced during the night.
sentences.zh: 这些限制仅在白天实行，夜间不执行。

sentences.en: On June 23, 2008, three days after Terneski's arrest, one of his cellmates awoke to the sound of running water just before 2am.
sentences.zh: 2008 年 6 月 23 日，特内斯基被捕三天后，凌晨 2 点前，他的一名室友被流水声惊醒。

sentences.en: The prisoner went into the bathroom and found Terneski on his knees with his arms by his side, face down in a bucket of dirty water.
sentences.zh: 那名囚犯走进浴室，发现特内斯基跪在地上，双臂垂在身侧，脸朝下浸在脏水桶里。

sentences.en: Correction officers rushed into the cell, but attempts to resuscitate him were unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 管教人员冲进牢房，但复苏尝试均告失败。

sentences.en: By the time a doctor arrived,
sentences.zh: 当医生赶到时，

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski was dead.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特内斯基已经死亡。

sentences.en: A search of his body revealed three items inside his pockets.
sentences.zh: 对他的尸体进行搜查时，在他的口袋里发现了三件物品。

sentences.en: A round-trip train ticket from Kachevo to Skopje, a blister pack of the antidepressant medication paroxetine, and a note directing authorities to check under the pillow on his bed.
sentences.zh: 一张从卡切沃到斯科普里的往返火车票、一板抗抑郁药物帕罗西汀，以及一张指示当局检查他床头枕头下的纸条。

sentences.en: There, they found a second note, which read,
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们发现了第二张纸条，上面写着，

sentences.en: I am proud of my family and I love them very much.
sentences.zh: 我为我的家人感到骄傲，我非常爱他们。

sentences.en: I have not done any of the things I am accused of.
sentences.zh: 我没有做任何被指控的事情。

sentences.en: I did not commit these murders.
sentences.zh: 我没有犯下这些谋杀案。

sentences.en: A subsequent autopsy of Terneski's body found the presence of water in his lungs, confirming drowning to be his cause of death.
sentences.zh: 随后对特内斯基尸体的尸检发现他的肺部有水，证实溺水是他的死因。

sentences.en: Other than a small bruise on his forehead which was sustained whilst his body spasmed during the drowning, there were no other signs of violence or defensive injuries
sentences.zh: 除了前额有一处在溺水时身体痉挛造成的轻微淤青外，没有其他暴力或防御性损伤的迹象

sentences.en: to suggest foul play was involved.
sentences.zh: 表明涉及谋杀。

sentences.en: Testing of the water in the bucket revealed no traces of sedatives, chemicals, or poisons.
sentences.zh: 对桶中水的检测显示没有镇静剂、化学品或毒药的痕迹。

sentences.en: The prison's governor confirmed Terneski had not been behaving suspiciously or raised any cause for concern in the day prior to his death.
sentences.zh: 监狱长证实，特内斯基在去世前一天并没有表现出可疑行为，也没有引起任何担忧。

sentences.en: He communicated well with his cellmates, ate all of his meals, and acted normally.
sentences.zh: 他与室友沟通良好，吃完了所有的饭菜，表现正常。

sentences.en: There were no marks or injuries on any of Terneski's cellmates to suggest that they could have been involved in his death in any way.
sentences.zh: 特内斯基的任何室友身上都没有伤痕或损伤，表明他们可能以任何方式参与了他的死亡。

sentences.en: During their attempts to resuscitate Terneski, prison guards had dragged him from the cell into a hallway, contaminating the scene.
sentences.zh: 在试图抢救特内斯基时，狱警将他从牢房拖到了走廊里，破坏了现场。

sentences.en: Without knowing specific facts like the exact positioning of Terneski's body at the time of his death, an inquest concluded the journalist had voluntarily ended his own life.
sentences.zh: 由于不知道特内斯基死亡时身体的具体位置等具体事实，调查结论认为这位记者是自愿结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson stated,
sentences.zh: 一位警方发言人表示，

sentences.en: He put his head in a pail full of water.
sentences.zh: 他把头伸进了一桶水里。

sentences.en: He ended his life like in a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 他像恐怖电影里那样结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: Under Macedonian criminal law, the prosecution of a deceased person is not permitted, meaning there would be no further legal proceedings against
sentences.zh: 根据马其顿刑法，不允许对已故人员进行起诉，这意味着不会再有针对

sentences.en: Vlado Terneski.
sentences.zh: 弗拉多·特内斯基的法律程序。

sentences.en: Given the highly unusual way that Terneski had chosen to end his life, conspiracy theories ran rife that implicated police in his death, with claims that correction officers had
sentences.zh: 鉴于特内斯基选择结束生命的方式非常不寻常，关于警方参与其死亡的阴谋论甚嚣尘上，有人声称管教人员

sentences.en: purposely sabotaged the crime scene to hinder any further investigations.
sentences.zh: 故意破坏了犯罪现场以阻碍进一步调查。

sentences.en: Some of the wilder theories suggest that the journalist had been a victim of waterboarding from officials desperate to extract a confession.
sentences.zh: 一些更疯狂的理论认为，这位记者是官员们为了迫使他认罪而进行水刑的受害者。

sentences.en: Some started to speculate that government officials had framed Terneski for the murders and orchestrated his death, with his DNA either planted or falsified to ensure the
sentences.zh: 有些人开始推测政府官员为了确保案件迅速解决而陷害特内斯基并策划了他的死亡，他的 DNA 要么是被栽赃的，要么是被伪造的，就像安特·罗斯特斯基和伊戈尔·

sentences.en: case was solved quickly, as with the botched conviction of Ante Rosteski and Igor
sentences.zh: 穆尔切斯基

sentences.en: Murcheski.
sentences.zh: 那起拙劣的定罪一样。

sentences.en: Although, this seemed highly unlikely given the
sentences.zh: 尽管考虑到

sentences.en: Republic of
sentences.zh: 马其顿共和国

sentences.en: Macedonia aimed to join the European
sentences.zh: 旨在加入欧盟，

sentences.en: Union, and any further significant failures of their judicial system would reflect poorly on the developing country.
sentences.zh: 司法系统的任何进一步重大失败都会对这个发展中国家产生负面影响，这看起来极不可能。

sentences.en: The Macedonian government had much more to gain from conducting a fair trial of the accused serial killer and delivering a verdict based on the presentation of fair and
sentences.zh: 马其顿政府通过对被指控的连环杀手进行公正审判，并根据公正和

sentences.en: factual evidence.
sentences.zh: 事实证据的呈现做出判决，能获得更多利益。

sentences.en: The conspiracy theories reached political level, with several journalists criticising
sentences.zh: 阴谋论上升到了政治层面，几位记者批评了
